title: Reading Drill — Improving a station's public clock — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Improving a station's public clock — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Cairnford began with reports of travellers seeing different times at opposite entrances. The station electrician had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using timed checks and chose the difference between clock readings as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a shared time signal. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted four weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded power interruptions as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
